title: 🎨 Card Preset
description: A named look & feel for a card: the combined attributes placed on the <ui-card> or <ui-reveal> element itself (variant, media, content token strings — plus reveal-specific attributes). Cards reference a preset instead of owning presentation, so restyling any card is a single reference swap. Presets are design-system data: invariant, not localized.

layout.name: Attributes
layout.description: Token strings written verbatim to the element's attributes

layout.name: Reveal
layout.description: Only used when element is ui-reveal

internalName.title: Internal Name
internalName.description: Internal name for CMS editors — not displayed on the front end

element.title: Element
element.description: Host element the attributes are applied to. ui-media / ui-content render the bare primitive with no card chrome — a standalone media frame or prose column living directly in a layout.

variant.title: variant=
variant.description: Card composition tokens: col | col-r | row | row-r, spl(1/2 …), ovr(tl…br), vis(media|content), rds(…)

theme.title: theme=
theme.description: Shared theme axis: one colour (red orange green blue accent white gray slate black) + optional modifiers pale | muted | light | dark. E.g. "black dark", "red pale", "gray". See ui/base/theme.md.

media.title: media=
media.description: Media frame tokens: asr(16/9 …), obf(), obp(), hov(), scm, clip … Carousel controls live here too — the ONLY form (no nav=/arrow=/dot= attributes): bare nav (dots + arrows), nav(dot|arw|blw|abv), arw(arr|sm|lg|xl|sqr|sft|hid|lgt|drk|bare|set|ts…be|blw|abv), dot(sm|md|lg|xl|pll|hyb|tmb|non|lgt|drk|ts…be|blw|abv), axis(y), auto, auto(4s), loop, stagger. Furniture styling also lives here, as single-value tokens (the CSS matches them by substring, so combine one value per token, not chip(ts red)): position chip|sticker|save|play(ts…be); hue chip|sticker|save(red|orange|green|blue|accent|white|gray|slate|black); sticker shape sticker(sh:burst|sh:spark|sh:sunburst|sh:heart|sh:blob|text|spl|spr) — clip silhouettes use the sh: prefix, custom ones too (sticker(sh:myshape) + inline --ui-sticker-clip-path); chip variant chip(lgt|out) and size chip(sm|lg|xl|2xl); save size save(sm|lg|xl) and disc save(crc|sqr|rnd|non); play size play(sm|lg|xl). The renderer emits the furniture elements from the card's content.furniture object and appends each item's optional style= override after these tokens (a same-axis override replaces the preset's token).

content.title: content=
content.description: Content column tokens: scl(sm|md|lg|xl), pad(), gap(), scr

text.title: Text mode
text.description: Which long text the content column shows: summary (teaser — the default for cards), body (full view — the body replaces the summary; falls back to summary when no body exists), or both. Reveal back panels always render both.

styles.title: Style overrides
styles.description: CSS custom properties written to the element's style attribute, e.g. { "--ui-reveal-content-bg": "#1f2937" }. Keys must start with --.

reveal.title: Reveal
reveal.description: Reveal configuration — only used when element is ui-reveal. The renderer folds these into compact variant= tokens where the animation carries its own direction: type+from → one token (expand → exp, flip+top → flp(top), slide+left → sld(lft), scale → scl), typeLg → lg:-prefixed swap (lg:scl), to → pop, trigger card → trg(card), scroll → scr; icon/iconClose positional words fold into one corner token — ts|te|bs|be ("top right" → ico(te)) plus style tokens (dark → drk, semi → sem, sm, lg). iconType stays markup (the toggle <ui-icon type>).

typeLg.title: type-lg=
typeLg.description: Reveal type override at the large container tier (e.g. expand on mobile, scale on desktop)

to.title: to=
to.description: Expand target — pop the panel to the viewport instead of in place

icon.title: icon=
icon.description: Toggle-icon tokens: position (top bottom left right) · style (dark semi) · size (sm lg), e.g. “top right sm”

iconType.title: Icon glyph
iconType.description: Glyph of the toggle <ui-icon> in the summary. Directional arrow-cross glyphs pair with slide reveals (panel from top → down-arrow-cross, bottom → up, left → right, right → left).

iconClose.title: icon-close=
iconClose.description: Close-icon tokens, e.g. “dark” or “dark top right”
